per_file.verdict: "LCA NEWSLETTER" now reads clearly in bright light gold above a larger "December 2026" on both the computer and phone bands, and the board looks as finished as the other two: an even mail window, a clean letter and a neat cream footer.

The masthead line is now bold navy at 13.5px on the computer, set between crisp rules under the large "LCA Newsletter", and the board matches the other two for finish while clearly being the traditional serif choice.

"LCA NEWSLETTER · NO. 2" now stands out in light gold at the same size and weight as option 1, above the very large "December". The cover and numbered sections look as finished as the other two and are clearly the boldest of the three.
